# ASRA Pain Medicine

> ASRA (American Society of Regional Anesthesia and Pain Medicine) is the leading professional organization providing clinical guidelines, educational resources, and peer-reviewed research for regional anesthesia and pain medicine practitioners.

ASRA serves pain medicine specialists and anesthesiologists with evidence-based guidelines, CME education, procedural training, and clinical tools. The organization operates multiple locations and publishes the peer-reviewed journal Regional Anesthesia & Pain Medicine.

## Key Topics

- Regional Anesthesia
- Pain Medicine
- Peripheral Nerve Blocks
- Point-of-Care Ultrasound (POCUS)
- Ultrasound-Guided Procedures
- Clinical Guidelines
- Nerve Block Techniques
- Acute Pain Management
- Chronic Pain Management
- Procedural Guides
- Evidence-Based Practice
- CME Education
- Medical Coding & Billing
- Physician Wellness
- Anesthesiology

## Getting Started

- [ASRA Pain Medicine Home](https://asra.com): ASRA Pain Medicine homepage with locations in Phoenix, Tampa, Houston
- [Become a Member](https://members.asra.com/memberships/become-a-member): ASRA membership registration and account creation portal

## Clinical Guidelines & Evidence

- [Guidelines](https://asra.com/guidelines-articles/guidelines): ASRA consensus guidelines on regional anesthesia and pain procedures
- [Guidelines & Articles](https://asra.com/guidelines-articles): ASRA clinical guidelines and articles on pain management topics
- [Regional Anesthesia & Pain Medicine Journal](https://asra.com/news-publications/regional-anesthesia-pain-medicine-journal): Official ASRA peer-reviewed journal with open access publishing
- [ASRA Pain Medicine Best](https://asra.com/guidelines-articles/asra-best-gallery): Educational resource gallery of best practices in regional anesthesia

## Procedural & Clinical Resources

- [Acute Pain Medicine](https://asra.com/guidelines-articles/original-articles/acute-pain-medicine): Procedural guides for nerve blocks and acute pain management techniques
- [Regional Anesthesia](https://asra.com/guidelines-articles/original-articles/regional-anesthesia): Regional anesthesia procedural guides and ultrasound-guided techniques
- [Chronic Pain Medicine](https://asra.com/guidelines-articles/original-articles/chronic-pain-medicine): Articles on chronic pain interventions and pain management techniques
- [Point-of-Care Ultrasound (POCUS)](https://asra.com/guidelines-articles/original-articles/point-of-care-ultrasound): POCUS guidelines and ultrasound training resources for perioperative use
- [How I Do It](https://asra.com/guidelines-articles/how-i-do-it): How-to articles on nerve blocks and pain management procedures

## Education & Learning

- [Online Education](https://asra.com/events-education/asra-pain-medicine-edge): ASRA Pain Medicine EDGE learning platform offering CME credits on-demand
- [Patient Education](https://asra.com/guidelines-articles/original-articles/patient-education): Patient resources on anesthesia types, pain management, and recovery
- [Apps](https://asra.com/guidelines-articles/asra-apps): ASRA clinical apps including ASRA Coags and ASRA LAST tools

## Practice & Professional Development

- [Practice Management](https://asra.com/guidelines-articles/original-articles/practice-management): Practice management, medical coding, and billing guidance for providers
- [Professional Issues](https://asra.com/guidelines-articles/original-articles/professional-issues): Professional development, physician wellness, and competency resources
- [News & Publications](https://asra.com/news-publications): ASRA news updates on pain medicine, advocacy, and clinical advances

## Optional Resources

- [Resource Center](https://asra.com/guidelines-articles/original-articles): ASRA resource center covering pain medicine, billing, and cannabinoids
- [Image Gallery](https://asra.com/guidelines-articles/image-gallery): Medical image gallery with copyright and usage guidelines
- [COVID-19 Resources](https://asra.com/guidelines-articles/original-articles/covid-19-resources): COVID-19 guidance for anesthesiology and regional anesthesia practice
